title: Fresh C24 calibration exceeded the diagnostics-on absolute performance ceiling

reproduction.other_budget_results: The other five total-time lanes and all four compiler-phase lanes passed.

root_cause.summary: The first fixed-order campaign crossed the independent diagnostics-on ceiling. An independent quiet-host exact C21/C24 replay then passed all ten budgets and measured diagnostics-on at 5.744 seconds, below the 8.0-second ceiling. This supports host or campaign variance rather than repeatable C24 cost, but does not rewrite the failed non-retryable context; a new immutable complete calibration remains required.

regression_propositions: a quiet-host exact C21/C24 paired campaign passes every relative and absolute performance budget
the diagnostics-on candidate median is at or below 8.0 seconds
the exact C21 and C24 package identities and Factorio 2.1.12 binary remain unchanged
a failed non-retryable performance TaskNode is never converted into passing evidence or reused
Control Plane v5 admission uses a new immutable context and a complete fresh calibration

closure.proof_required: a complete fresh C24 calibration under a new immutable context; the retained quiet-host exact paired pass satisfies the independent performance reproduction proposition but is not substituted for calibration closure
